title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor
source_version: PMLR volume 80, ICML 2018, proceedings pages 1861-1870; publisher main PDF, retrieved 2026-09-28

claims.statement: The objective combines expected rewards and policy entropy; temperature alpha sets their relative weight, and the reward-only objective is recovered as alpha approaches zero.
claims.unsupported_extension: Does not establish automatic temperature tuning.

claims.statement: SAC independently trains two Q-functions and uses their minimum in the value and policy gradients to reduce positive bias.
claims.unsupported_extension: Does not guarantee removal of all estimation bias.

claims.statement: The comparison uses five seeded runs per algorithm, one evaluation rollout every 1000 environment steps, mean curves, and minimum-to-maximum shading.

evidence_locator.table_or_figure: Figure 1 protocol; figure is on PDF page 6

claims.unsupported_extension: Shading is not a confidence interval.

retrieval_queries.query: How often was performance checked, and how were repeated benchmark runs aggregated?
